AGENT.API_KEY_MISSING: No API key has been set for this provider. Open Settings and go to Direct API to enter one.
AGENT.LLM_AUTH_FAILED: The provider did not accept the API key. Check the key in Settings.
AGENT.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: Model "{model}" was not found at the selected provider. Pick a different model.
AGENT.LLM_RATE_LIMITED: The provider is limiting requests for now. Try again in a few minutes.
AGENT.LLM_UNREACHABLE: Could not connect to the provider. Check your network or the server address.
AGENT.LLM_REQUEST_FAILED: The provider reported an error while handling the request. Try again.
AGENT.INVALID_MESSAGES: The conversation content is not valid. Start a new conversation.
AGENT.CLI_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: The selected CLI profile was not found. Pick a different one.
AGENT.CLI_NOT_INSTALLED: The command "{command}" is not installed on this computer. Install it and try again.
AGENT.CLI_SPEC_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: This profile needs at least one Spec for the Agent to read. Pick a Spec and send again.
AGENT.CLI_SPAWN_FAILED: Could not start the CLI Agent. Check the command in Settings.
AGENT.CLI_EXIT_NONZERO: The CLI Agent stopped with an error (code {exitCode}). See the log for details.
AGENT.CLI_TIMEOUT: The CLI Agent ran too long and was stopped. Try again with a smaller request.
AGENT.SANDBOX_FAILED: Could not create a temporary copy to run the CLI Agent. Try again.
AGENT.RUN_NOT_FOUND: This CLI Agent run was not found.
AGENT.RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE: This Workspace already has a CLI Agent run in progress. Wait for it or stop it first.
AGENT.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: This conversation was not found (it may have been deleted).
AGENT.CLI_PERMISSION_DENIED: The CLI Agent could not do anything because tool permissions were denied while running in the background. Choose the “Skip confirmations” permission level and send again.
